metadata.scenario: A customer questions the unexpected charges on their latest bill and demands an explanation. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Helen Johnson. I’m calling about some unexpected charges on my latest bill. I'm sorry to hear that, Helen. Let me pull up your account. One moment, please. Sure, take your time. I just don't understand some of these additional fees. Thank you for your patience. I see that you've been with us for physical therapy. Yes, I've been a client for about nine months now. Right, I see a recent charge for an extra session and medication management services. But I didn’t schedule an extra session, and I wasn’t aware of medication management being added! I understand your concern. Let me check the notes on your account regarding those charges. Thank you. I really need clarity on this, especially since I was only expecting the routine therapy fees. Absolutely, I’ll get you the detailed breakdown. Just a moment. It looks like there was a miscommunication—the medication management was accidentally added when we updated your care plan. That's frustrating. I didn't request that service. What can we do about this? I can remove that charge for you. It shouldn't have been included. Okay, but what about the extra session charge? Let me investigate that further. I see a note indicating a session was scheduled due to a last-minute change in your therapy plan. Was that not communicated to you? No, I wasn’t informed at all. I would have opted out if I’d known. I apologize for that confusion. We can certainly adjust this. I'll issue a credit for that charge as well. Thank you, I appreciate that. Can you confirm when I’ll see the changes reflected? The adjustments should reflect by the end of the week. I’ll follow up to ensure everything is resolved. Great, thank you. Also, since I’m managing my recovery, can you tell me about any additional skilled nursing services you offer? Certainly! We have skilled nursing care, including medication management and post-surgical recovery support. Sounds like something I might need. Can you send me more information on that? Absolutely, I’ll send you a detailed email today, along with a follow-up on your billing. Thank you, Margaret. I feel much better about this now. I’m glad to hear that, Helen. Is there anything else I can assist you with? No, that’s everything for now. Thank you for your help! You’re welcome! Have a great day, and take care! You too, bye! Goodbye!
